stories.title: Pakistan and Singapore Review Aviation and Bilateral Relations
stories.summary: Pakistan's foreign minister met with his Singaporean counterpart to talk about bringing back direct flights and strengthening bilateral ties as both nations celebrate 60 years of diplomatic relations.

stories.title: Geo News and UN Women Partner for Gender Equality
stories.summary: UN Women Pakistan and Geo News partnered through the UN Women Global Media Compact to help advance gender equality initiatives.

stories.title: قطری وفد ایران کے ساتھ تعلقات اور علاقائی صورتحال پر بات چیت کے لیے تہران پہنچ گیا
stories.summary: قطری وزیرِ اعظم اور وزیرِ خارجہ کے سینئر مشیر کی قیادت میں ایک وفد جمعہ کی صبح تہران پہنچ گیا۔ ایرانی خبر رساں ادارے کے مطابق یہ وفد تہران میں ایرانی حکام سے ملاقاتیں کرے گا، جن میں باہمی تعلقات اور خطے کی مجموعی صورتحال پر تبادلہ خیال کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: Kyoto University Hospital Performs First Stem-Cell Parkinson's Treatment
stories.summary: Sumitomo Pharma announced that the first patient received a stem-cell therapy for Parkinson's disease at Kyoto University Hospital in October. The procedure involves transplanting millions of induced pluripotent stem cells into the patient's brain following regulatory approval in March.

stories.title: Punjab Launches Complimentary Guest Relations Officer Program for Females
stories.summary: The Punjab region has introduced a free Guest Relations Officer course designed specifically for women.

stories.title: دو تجزیاتی اداروں نے اربوں ڈالر کی کرپٹو چوری کا تعلق شمالی کوریا سے جوڑ دیا
stories.summary: دو کرپٹو تجزیاتی اداروں نے ایک بڑے ہیکنگ حملے کا سراغ لگاتے ہوئے اس کا تعلق شمالی کوریا کے ہیکنگ گروپ ٹریڈر ٹریٹر کے ساتھ جوڑا ہے۔

stories.title: Zee Entertainment Profit Drops 38% Amid Higher Costs
stories.summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises reported a 38% decline in quarterly profit down to 478 million rupees due to expenses linked to FIFA World Cup broadcasting and other programming investments, which offset subscription growth.

stories.title: Copper Faces First Monthly Decline Since June on Market Jitters
stories.summary: Copper prices dropped, heading toward a 1% decline for October and ending a three-month winning streak. The drop was driven by technology sector jitters regarding artificial intelligence spending returns, alongside higher oil prices.

stories.title: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia Expand Energy and Mining Cooperation
stories.summary: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia agreed to enhance cooperation in the minerals sector, oil storage, refinery upgrades, and fuel procurement. Additionally, Saudi Arabia launched same-day visa processing for Pakistani citizens at its Islamabad embassy.

stories.title: Prime Minister Sharif Praises Singapore's Economic Growth
stories.summary: During a meeting with Singapore's foreign minister, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif praised Singapore's economic transformation and innovation achievements. The officials discussed increasing bilateral trade, investment, and cooperation in technology and infrastructure as they mark 60 years of diplomatic ties.

stories.title: Four Fatally Injured in AJK House Gas Cylinder Blast
stories.summary: Four individuals lost their lives following a gas cylinder explosion inside a residential property located in Bagh, Azad Jammu and Kashmir.

stories.title: Sazgar Launches New Vehicle Manufacturing Plant in the Philippines
stories.summary: Pakistani automaker Sazgar Engineering Works Limited has established a manufacturing facility in Laguna province, Philippines. The plant aims to produce about 12,000 electric and internal combustion three-wheelers annually. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. noted the investment will aid the local manufacturing sector, create jobs, and support cleaner transportation.

stories.title: Hackers Steal Record $6.3 Billion from Binance Exchange
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion theft by hackers, an attack analysts attributed to North Korea. Binance paused withdrawals and promised to cover the losses using company funds and reserves, while stablecoin issuers managed to quickly freeze roughly half of the stolen funds.

stories.title: Security Forces Intercept and Destroy Five Drones in Balochistan
stories.summary: Pakistani security personnel successfully shot down five drones in the Kharan District of Balochistan before they could strike their intended target at an Albat area check-post. Authorities reported no casualties resulting from the attempted drone strike.

stories.title: West Indies Claims Advantage Over Bangladesh Following Collapse in Mirpur
stories.summary: West Indies seized control of the match in Mirpur after a batting collapse by Bangladesh was triggered by Chase.

stories.title: Tech Giants Lose UK Court Challenge Over Regulatory Data Requests
stories.summary: Meta, TikTok, and X failed in their London High Court legal challenge against British regulator Ofcom. The companies contested information notices requiring detailed content moderation data under the 2023 Online Safety Act, which carries potential fines up to 10 percent of global turnover for serious violations.

stories.title: Pakistan Gold Prices Drop Following International Market Declines
stories.summary: Gold rates in Pakistan dropped on Friday, mirroring a decrease in global markets. The price per tola fell by Rs5,100 to settle at Rs420,536, while 10 grams dropped by Rs4,373 to Rs360,541. Globally, gold decreased by $51 to reach $3,980 per ounce, and domestic silver prices also fell by Rs238 per tola.

stories.title: Government States Currency Devaluation Increased Fuel and Construction Expenses
stories.summary: The government acknowledged that the devaluation of the rupee caused a rise in expenses related to fuel, construction, and dams.

stories.title: Phillips Scores Outstanding Century to Lead Team Past India
stories.summary: Phillips achieved a notable century during a match, helping secure an 87-run victory over India.

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Slips Upward Versus US Dollar
stories.summary: The Pakistani currency registered a slight increase against the US dollar in the inter-bank market on Friday, finishing at 276.75 compared to 276.76 on Thursday. Meanwhile, the dollar declined alongside US Treasury yields amid an AI share sell-off, and the Japanese yen traded steadily ahead of an anticipated Bank of Japan rate decision.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Inflation Reaches 8.3 Percent in October
stories.summary: Sri Lanka's Colombo Consumer Price Index increased by 8.3% year-on-year in October, exceeding September's 8% rate. Food inflation climbed to 8.8%, and non-food inflation reached 8%. Inflation has hit a three-year high since July due to rising energy costs linked to the Iran war, while the central bank maintains its rates and targets 5% inflation.

stories.title: Three Police Officers Killed in Separate KP Attacks
stories.summary: Three policemen lost their lives in distinct assaults across the KP region.

stories.title: Deadline Set for PSL 12 Player Retention
stories.summary: Officials confirmed the final date for player retention ahead of the 12th season of the PSL.

stories.title: MIT Solutions Claims President's Trophy Grade-I Victory Over SBP
stories.summary: MIT Solutions defeated SBP to capture the President's Trophy Grade-I championship.
